title: Device fleet
description: Gateways and meters across tenants: connectivity per building, stock in the inventory and every device with its ring, firmware and last heartbeat.
driftBody: The gateway reported a configuration that differs from the published one ({date}). It is sent again until it applies.
rejectedTitle: Version {version} was rejected by the gateway
commandsHint: Sent after commit and re-sent until the gateway acknowledges; log uploads link to their file.

import.title: Import devices into the stock
import.hint: One device per line: serial,kind,model,vendor and optionally driver,ownership,arch. Any error refuses the whole file; serials already registered are skipped.
import.refused: {count, plural, one {# line has} other {# lines have}} errors — nothing was imported
import.pasteHint: The first line is the header
import.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {# line skipped} other {# lines skipped}}

actions.assignHint: The device goes to the tenant's building; a gateway then gets a provisioning code for the installer.
actions.noBuildings: This tenant has no building yet — create one in the tenant's console first.
actions.setRingHint: Canary gateways get a release first, then pilot, then all (D-183).
actions.commandHint: Queued while the gateway is offline and sent when it reconnects, until it expires.
actions.revokeBody: The gateway is disconnected at once and must be provisioned again with a new code. Use it for a stolen or compromised gateway.
actions.retireBody: The device leaves the fleet for good. Its history stays.
actions.codeHint: Give it to the installer; it works once, until {date}.

ota.title: OTA releases
ota.description: Signed gateway releases and their rollouts ring by ring: canary, then pilot, then all. A rollout pauses by itself when failures pass its limit.
ota.registerHint: Upload the agent binary to the product bucket under releases/edge/VERSION/FILE first, then paste the manifest the release build produced. The API checks the signature against the platform key and that the binary is there with the signed size.
ota.manifestHint: version, arch, channel, artifact (url, sha256, size), signature (alg, keyId, value)
ota.manifestJson: The manifest is not valid JSON
ota.manifestShape: The manifest needs version, arch, artifact.url, artifact.sha256 and signature.value
ota.artifactMissing: Version {version}'s agent binary is not in the product bucket with the size the manifest signs. A release engineer (release-publisher role) uploads it to {key} in the environment's bucket (collective-uat- or collective-prod-getproperty-assets) first — the platform cannot write there (getproperty-api docs/deployment.md §5a); then register the same manifest again.
ota.planHint: The rollout starts when you start it. A ring waits for the previous ring of this release to complete.
ota.maxFailuresHint: Share of gateways that may fail before the rollout pauses
ota.startBody: {count, plural, one {# gateway receives} other {# gateways receive}} the update, a few at a time.
ota.pauseBody: Gateways already updating finish; no new gateway starts.
ota.resumeBody: The next gateways receive the update.
ota.abortBody: No other gateway is updated. Gateways keep the version they run now.
ota.live: Live — updates as the gateways report
ota.notLive: Not live — reload to see the latest

ingest.title: Ingest dead letters
ingest.description: Telemetry the platform refused, with the reason and a preview of the payload. Replay once the cause is fixed.
ingest.replayBody: The stored payload goes through ingest again as if it had just arrived.
